title: Transferring Peptide-Target Interaction Patterns to Small Molecules by Joint Guidance for Diffusion and Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.41322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating small molecules to target protein-protein interactions (PPIs) remains one of the most challenging yet high-reward frontiers in drug discovery. Unlike traditional small-molecule drugs that bind to deep, well-defined pockets, PPI interfaces often comprise broad, shallow binding surfaces. A natural strategy is to leverage known peptide-target interactions, as peptide ligands provide rich interface-level constraints. However, a major algorithmic challenge is that rigid atom-level conditioning on peptide structures can over-constrain the generative space and exclude valid small-molecule solutions. To address this challenge, we present PIFT (Peptide InterFace Transfer), a novel framework that transfers peptide-target interaction patterns to small molecules through joint sampling-time guidance of masked discrete diffusion and continuous flow matching. translated_title: 通过扩散与流匹配的联合引导将肽-靶标相互作用模式迁移至小分子
translated_abstract: 生成靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）的小分子仍然是药物发现中最具挑战性但回报也最高的前沿领域之一。与结合于深且明确口袋的传统小分子药物不同，PPI界面通常由宽广而浅的结合表面构成。一种自然的策略是利用已知的肽-靶标相互作用，因为肽配体能够提供丰富的界面级约束。然而，一个主要的算法挑战在于，对肽结构施加刚性的原子级条件约束会过度限制生成空间，从而排除有效的小分子解。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了PIFT（Peptide InterFace Transfer，肽界面迁移），这是一个新颖的框架，通过对掩码离散扩散和连续流匹配进行采样阶段的联合引导，将肽-靶标相互作用模式迁移到小分子上。PIFT首先将肽-靶标界面与小分子-靶标界面映射到一个共享的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PIFT框架通过在采样阶段对掩码离散扩散与连续流匹配进行联合引导，将肽-靶标界面的相互作用模式迁移到小分子生成中，从而实现靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用界面的小分子药物设计。
en_tdlr: PIFT transfers peptide-target interaction patterns to small-molecule generation via joint sampling-time guidance of masked discrete diffusion and continuous flow matching, enabling the design of small molecules targeting protein-protein interaction interfaces.
